materialEvents.summary: ledger ingest reported BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION on live worktree
receipt commits moved Git HEAD and caused freshness treadmill

decisions.decision: Use content-hash freshness instead of Git HEAD for harvest publication
decisions.reason: Pointer-only commits were invalidating durable L: harvests
alternativesRejected: Continue comparing freshness to Git HEAD
consequences: Phase C pointer no longer triggers republication treadmill

corrections.incorrectAgentClaim: Supabase ledger ingest can read the live Cross-Agent worktree during publication
corrections.operatorCorrection: Projection must consume immutable snapshot input only
corrections.correctedTruth: AppBuilder projector reads compact JSON input; live worktree mutation is forbidden
corrections.futureAgentRule: Never use cross-agent-ledger live-worktree ingest for harvest publication

durableClaims.claim: L: owns the complete durable harvest authority
Supabase stores compact projection and L: pointer only

mistakes.attemptedAction: Run ledger ingest against live mutable worktree during publication
mistakes.whyItSeemedReasonable: Ingest historically read active work-progress files for freshness
mistakes.actualOutcome: BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION and unsafe coupling to Git state
mistakes.rootCause: Publication path reused live worktree ingest instead of immutable snapshot
mistakes.optimalFirstMove: Build compact projection from L: durable catalog and invoke AppBuilder projector

blindRetrieval.question: Why did ledger ingest report BLOCKED_GIT_MUTATION during harvest publication?
When should an existing harvest seed return NOOP_CURRENT instead of republishing?
